control.name: Independent Production Change Approval
control.description: Production changes must follow documented change control procedures including authorization by authorized parties.

results.recommended_action: No action required. Change is fully compliant.
Reject change. Enforce segregation of duties (SoD) by requiring an independent approver.

findings.message: Implementer and approver are the same individual (SoD violation).

results.recommended_action: Reject change. Approver lacks formal delegation of authority or authorization status is unverified.

findings.message: Approver authorization is missing, unverified, or explicitly unauthorized.

results.recommended_action: Initiate post-implementation review and enforce pre-deployment gate in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.message: Change was implemented before formal approval timestamp.

results.recommended_action: Schedule retroactive Change Advisory Board (CAB) review for emergency override.

findings.message: Emergency change requires mandatory retroactive CAB review.
